themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents and systems designed to autonomously perform research tasks, from data collection to analysis and execution.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, debug, refactor, and understand code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses articles discussing the landscape, comparison, and impact of AI tools specifically designed for research purposes.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles detailing research into the use, behavior, and impact of AI chatbots, particularly in user interaction and support contexts.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores how AI is being applied to aid in the design process and enhance UX research methodologies.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers AI's ability to condense large amounts of text into concise summaries for research and information consumption.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Focuses on articles that directly compare different AI tools for research tasks, evaluating their performance and features.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting jobs, skills, hiring, and overall workforce dynamics.

themes.name: AI assisted recruitment
themes.description: Details the use of AI in hiring processes, from sourcing candidates to interview analysis and selection.

themes.name: AI ethics in research
themes.description: Addresses the ethical considerations and challenges of using AI in research and product development.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
